newsitem.title: USA: LPC-Republic Industries taps banks for $1.5 bln.
newsitem.headline: LPC-Republic Industries taps banks for $1.5 bln.

text.p: NEW YORK, March 6 (LPC) - Several major banks on Thursday will launch syndication of a $1.5 billion loan for Republic Industries Inc, market sources said.
Taking part in the loan are administrative agent NationsBank Corp, syndication agents Chase Manhattan Corp and Citibank and documentation agent BankAmerica Corp.
The five-year deal is split between a $1 billion revolver and a $500 million synthetic lease facility.
The larger revolver, which takes out a $250 million facility put in place in December 1995, will be used for general corporate purposes and acquisitions.
The pricing is tied to debt-to-capitalization. The agents are seeking co-agents prior to the March 18 bank meeting in Fort Lauderdale, Fla. Nominal upfront fees are on offer.
